metadata.description: One-plugin marketplace that bootstraps gstack (garrytan/gstack) into Claude Code. gstack is not a plugin: it is a 70+ skill bundle that installs to ~/.claude/skills/gstack via its own build script. This marketplace ships a single installer plugin so a team can add the marketplace, install it, and run one skill that performs gstack's real clone + setup.

plugins.name: gstack-installer
plugins.description: Installs and updates gstack (Garry Tan's Claude Code setup: 70+ slash-command skills for CEO/eng/design review, QA, browser, ship, security). Runs the upstream clone + setup so the browse binary compiles and every skill registers natively. Idempotent: updates in place if already installed.
